issues.on_page: General Fund Taxes final budget 8,926,966 (whole line, actual 7,893,411)
issues.issue: The budget for the whole Taxes line is put on the property piece (7,166,466), and the motor vehicle piece (detail[1]) carries null. So the property piece's budget variance is misleading. The computed text says so.

issues.on_page: Road Fund DISBURSEMENTS 2,241,493 (p4 Road column: Public works 1,464,566 + Capital outlay 776,927)
issues.issue: The whole Road Fund line is filed as streets/highways, although p4 shows 776,927 of it is capital outlay. The ARPA one-line disbursement (detail[48-49]) was split by its p4 column instead, so the two are treated inconsistently. Amount and budget are right.
